title: AMLC flags VP Sara’s transactions ‘linked’ to flood control, drugs | The wRap
summary: Today’s headlines: Sara Duterte, NCAP, Asian Games

blocks.text: Today’s headlines: Sara Duterte, NCAP, Asian Games
Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Flagged transactions of Sara Duterte ‘linked’ to flood control, drugs – AMLC

blocks.text: The prosecution says the Anti-Money Laundering Council flagged financial transactions of Vice President Sara Duterte allegedly related to flood projects and illegal drugs.

items: Why BPI asked AMLC to delete P2-B worth of transactions from Duterte-Carpio records

blocks.text: A system bug had caused some BPI transaction records linked to Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband Mans Carpio to appear much larger.

items: ‘No toilet, tiles?’ Estrada office stripped bare ahead of Sotto turnover

blocks.text: Senator Jinggoy Estrada’s office in the Senate is stripped bare ahead of its turnover to Senate President Pro Tempore Tito Sotto.

items: NCAP returns in 5 Metro Manila cities

blocks.text: The no-contact apprehension policy or NCAP will be implemented again STARTING Monday, October 5, in the cities of Manila, Muntinlupa, Parañaque, San Juan, and Quezon City.

items: PH nets biggest Asian Games medal haul in 6 decades

blocks.text: The Philippines achieves its largest medal haul at the Asian Games in 60 years, finishing with 29 medals: 4 golds, 9 silvers, and 16 bronzes. – Rappler.com
